description: Put a drawing on a sheet (id, number or name) where there's clear room, at the largest usual scale that fits unless scale is given: kind plan (level), elevation or section (view south|north|east|west|section-ew|section-ns), view (a saved view's picture, in the style saved with it unless style is given; scaled draws it at scale in parallel projection), schedule (view = openings|rooms|walls|slabs|stairs|columns|beams|ramps|lifts|parking|furniture, or a saved report's name) or note (text). x, y: its centre, mm from the sheet's top left.

edges.description: With a style: edges (always on in hiddenline and sketch)

profiles.description: With a style: thicker silhouette outlines

scaled.description: A view drawn at scale (parallel projection from its direction)

style.description: A view's style: scene (as saved with the view) or a face style (default is Solid)

name: place_drawing
title: Place a drawing on a sheet
